subject: literacy
concept: Reading a passage rich in figurative language and precise vocabulary, applying all vocabulary skills together
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student follows along with pictures while reading a passage with rich vocabulary and figurative language
exercise.abstract: Student reads a passage and explains at least one root-based word, one figurative phrase, and the overall tone

assessment.mastery_threshold: correctly explains all three required elements
misconception_flags: can decode the vocabulary but not explain its function within the passage

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
